title: Session events timeline
description: Event and phase windows (log seconds) from the session notes, used to label the charts; phases sit inside their numbered session event.

title: Spot 1 magnetometer readings
description: Every field line of the spot-1 log (x, y, z in µT) with position s along the clean-sweep line, distance off that line, |B| and the event it falls in.

title: Bench fridge-magnet test
description: Every field line of the bench log, with change = distance in µT from the resting field (mean of 18.2–19.5 s).

title: Clean sweep passes
description: Readings from the clean up-pass (302.5–338 s) and down-pass (344–392 s), with progress through each pass measured in time from the lever-down end.

title: Pedalling vs stopped segments
description: Mean, spread and range of position s for each pedalling and stopped stretch (2 s trimmed off each end).

title: Follow-the-path reference chain
description: The clean up-sweep (302.5–338 s) resampled every 4 µT of path length: the calibrated path used by the follow-the-path method.

title: Method sensitivity along lever
description: For each step of the reference chain, the share of real field change each method turns into position change (straight line = cosine of the angle to the line), over 4 µT and smoother 12 µT steps.

title: Methods on the down-sweep
description: Each down-sweep reading (344–392 s) located by both methods: position in % of range and distance from the reference (off-line vs off-chain).

title: Methods on known lever positions
description: Readings where the lever position is mechanically known (fully down = 0 %, fully up = 100 %): each method's position error, health signal, and the share of readings its health flag catches (straight line > 15 µT, path > 8 µT).

title: Slow crank revolution trace
description: Readings around the slow crank turn (lever fully down): change from the starting reading, and both methods' position and health signal.

title: Simulated curved path: estimates
description: SIMULATED, not measured: a field path turning through 250° (radius 60 µT) with 0.2 µT noise; 101 test readings located by both methods after a 25-point calibration.

title: Simulated curved path: shape
description: SIMULATED, not measured: the noise-free simulated field path (top view, µT) and its 25 noisy calibration points with their straight-line positions.

title: Phone-dictated readings
description: Readings read aloud from the phone before tonight's log (first taping, then re-taped); position and off-line distance use their own line from the mean re-taped down to the mean re-taped up reading.

title: Spot 1 headline figures
description: The headline figures for spot 1, each computed from the logs, with the pass limit where one applies (span at least 100 µT, crank effect at most 1.5 µT).

title: Spot 1 computed findings
description: Every other number quoted on the dashboard, computed from the logs by build_data.py (vectors in vx, vy, vz).
